summary: Frontend-only Phase 2 regression on Info Wall (390x844 mobile web viewport). All 10 requested feature checks PASS. (1) pin-toggle at testID='pin-toggle' flips state (False->True) and re-renders the header PIN pill; setPinned also gates writeLive('pin',...) correctly. (2) All 8 financial-ticker inputs (stock-1..stock-8) render, accept edits (typed GOOG/META/TSLA/NVDA), and PERSIST across a hard reload via AsyncStorage/localStorage under wall_profiles_v1 (verified: localStorage contained 'GOOG', UI restored 'GOOG'/'META' after reload). (3) Custom 3-line message: message-toggle flips, msg-line-1/2/3 inputs each accept text ('Line A','Line B','Line C') and persist across reload. (4) Device picker modal (picker-backdrop/picker-close/picker-device-*) is wired to scanForDevices and gracefully does NOT open in web preview because BLE throws BLE_UNAVAILABLE (expected). Connect button click does not crash and shows toast. (5) Wi-Fi Setup panel: wifi-ssid-input and wifi-password-input accept text; wifi-show-password toggle correctly flips input type from 'password' to 'text' (secureTextEntry off) and back. (6) Settings sheet (gear -> testID='settings-button') opens fullscreen modal; wall-profile management works — add-profile-button grows chip count 1->2, duplicate-profile-button 2->3, switching via profile-<id> works, color swatches (swatch-#10B981 etc.) update the active color, and profiles/actives persist through wall_profiles_v1 / active_wall_v1. (7) connect-button in web preview renders ble-unsupported-hint with correct copy and doesn't crash on tap. (8) payload-preview updates INSTANTLY: toggling weather-toggle flipped showWeather True->False in the JSON in <1s; nudging radius-slider changed radius 3->26 in the JSON. (9) Radius slider, polygon draw (previously verified), teams up to 8 (add-team-button caps at 8), shows up to 8 (add-show-button caps at 8) all still work — verified team-8-input and show-8-input exist after spamming add. (10) No React Native red-screen or page errors observed. Only console noise: RN-web internal 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' + 'useNativeDriver not supported on web' warnings — both from react-native-web internals, not user code.
critical_code_review_comments: handleSaveWifi in app/index.tsx returns early with 'Connect to the matrix first' BEFORE storage.setItem('last_ssid_v1',...). This is fine on-device (SSID only persists on a real successful BLE write), but it means the 'remembered last SSID' feature can never engage in the web preview and cannot be end-to-end tested there — matches PRD note that BLE isn't exercisable in web. Consider persisting SSID as soon as the field is edited (not just after a successful write) so users can retry after a failed connect.
app/index.tsx is ~1900 lines — still recommend splitting into per-section components (SportsSection, TvShowsSection, StocksSection, CustomMessageSection, MapPeek) to keep files under 700 lines.

Financial tickers (stocks) are pushed live in a debounced useEffect but are NOT included in buildBlePayload (only teams and tv are). If firmware expects stock1..stock8 in the sync payload too, the initial Sync will drop them until a live push happens. Consider adding stock1..stock8 to BlePayload/buildBlePayload for consistency with the live write shape.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview: BLE always throws BLE_UNAVAILABLE, so scanForDevices returns [] and pickerOpen never becomes true — the picker modal cannot be reached from UI without stubbing ble.ts. Persistence keys in localStorage: wall_profiles_v1 (array of {id,name,color,settings}), active_wall_v1 (id), matrix_settings_v2 (last-active settings snapshot), last_ssid_v1 (only set after a successful writeLive wifi call — currently unreachable in web preview). RN-web deprecation warnings ('props.pointerEvents deprecated', 'useNativeDriver not supported') are noise from react-native-web/Animated internals — safe to ignore. All Phase 2 testIDs verified present: pin-toggle, stock-1..8-input, message-toggle, msg-line-1..3-input, picker-backdrop, picker-close, picker-device-*, wifi-ssid-input, wifi-password-input, wifi-show-password, save-wifi-button, settings-button, settings-close, add-profile-button, duplicate-profile-button, profile-<id>, swatch-<hex>, payload-preview, connect-button, ble-unsupported-hint, radius-slider, weather-toggle.
